note: ref is the git ref where path exists. pending true means that ref is an open draft branch and default_branch does not contain path yet. After the pull request merges, Lead re-saves from default_branch. Grok Bot copies never write back. desk_copy, when set, is the programming-desk mirror of an upstream skill. Ultrathink rows pinned to c8c62900a6e830d2d94a2a35f87a6f9b4fad04eb are on claude-ultrathink main after #22-#30 and #32. gsd-runtime text marked requires claude-ultrathink#34 depends on fix/omp-planning-cancellation at 87411ed (pull request 34), which is not merged.

skills.name: ultrathink-protocol
skills.purpose: Standing rule: capture Ming's request and plan it with the grokbot host loop before acting.

skills.name: ultrathink-off
skills.purpose: Turns native ultrathink planning off for Desk Lead until /ultrathink-on.

skills.name: ultrathink-on
skills.purpose: Turns native ultrathink planning back on for the box.

skills.name: ultrathink-quick
skills.purpose: Answers one message directly as typed, with no planning and no Linear or Notion rows.

skills.name: ultrathink-skip
skills.purpose: Skips planning for the next message only.

skills.name: ultrathink-status
skills.purpose: Shows planning on or off, the Desk Lead host engine, tracking, ship, Jev, teach, and the last plan.

skills.name: ultrathink-track
skills.purpose: Keeps planning and starts or stops Linear/Notion row creation.

skills.name: ultrathink-think
skills.purpose: Toggles Graph of Thought or shows the last graph sketch and waves.

skills.name: ultrathink-engine
skills.purpose: Shows the planning engine route. On the box it stays host:grok-bot.

skills.name: ultrathink-last
skills.purpose: Shows the last uplifted spec as a path and a short summary.

skills.name: ultrathink-lessons
skills.purpose: Lists, recalls, or promotes lessons. Promotion writes a draft only.

skills.name: ultrathink-hitl
skills.purpose: Toggles the clarifier or shows the last questions and answers.

skills.name: ultrathink-teach-admin
skills.purpose: Full Teachable Moments CLI. Promote stays drafts-only.

skills.name: ultrathink-pstack
skills.purpose: Critique alternative, unit flags, Cursor /gsd-* skill map, and the repeated-finding hand-off. Upstream has no SKILL.md.

skills.name: gsd-ship-pr
skills.purpose: Plugin ship path on main c8c6290. Ming's VPS keeps ship.autoMerge and ship.deleteBranch on.

skills.name: gsd-runtime
skills.purpose: Omp planning flight. Paragraphs marked requires claude-ultrathink#34 need PR 34 at 87411ed.

skills.name: swarm-cloud-dispatch
skills.purpose: Lead hands a repository to a Cursor cloud agent that runs the 15 AgentSwarm agents as subagents and returns a draft pull request.

skills.name: desk-shared-memory
skills.purpose: Calls the seat gateway for brief, recall, retain, docs, events, ownership, receipts and doctor. Memory is reached only through that gateway.

skills.name: desk-run
skills.purpose: One /desk-run command that chains planning, gateway memory and Cursor cloud dispatch through to a draft pull request and the Greptile gate.
